speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: And you brought back more of my feathers. Even better!

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: No, I mean to say that I am a Count, not that [i]you[/i] should begin [i]counting[/i].

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: I bet the aristoquacksy in Tertil doesn't have to put up with this...

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: Why are you still standing here when there are more down feathers to find?

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: While ducking, hold the S key to charge and then press the SPACE bar to jump.
